edit.description: Earlier robust response to large residuals, then baseline curvature; not a tolerance radius
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity response: no decoded final-affinity labels were observed, so an improvement in final predicted target affinity cannot be claimed from this edit; the primary objective remains unverified.

Gradient cancellation: the delta schedule changes only the robust-vs-baseline weighting of the same scalar reward, so component gradients could partially cancel and leave the delivered injection direction nearly unchanged; distinguishing this from an unsuitable target requires a gradient-direction check and a realized-dose audit, not just a changed scalar value.

Timing attribution: if C1 does not differ from C2 (constant curvature) and C3 (opposite timing) on the same seeds, any apparent benefit is not attributable to timing; a constant-blend and time-order control comparison is required.
Support mismatch: the recipe is only valid on the observed score nodes within [0.0,0.49]; any evaluation outside that window is extrapolation and is disallowed.

Proxy limitation: landmark_00_local_dx is a coordinate proxy in predicted endpoint world coordinates with no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation, and only one feature was read in full, so the edit may not represent other landmark coordinates.
Strain and structural validity are secondary and were not assessed here; a coordinate-contrast change does not establish improved strain or validity.
rationale: Analyst H001/H002, grounded in the actual landmark_00_local_dx curve (E4bbe368c52deda38) and its continuous-trend row (Eace79c1f0f54c9d1), report a non-monotone contrast with a near-zero whole-window mean but large within-window excursion, 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 batches, with the quadratic rejected and extrapolation disallowed. That supports a time-dependent treatment of this coordinate rather than a single fixed endpoint target, and the observed support [0.0,0.49] matches the registered recipe knots [0,0.5,1] with no extrapolation. Among the offered reward-route curvature recipes, C1_robust_to_base (delta 0.5->0.75->1.0, dose fixed at 1, blend 0) is the only one that makes the early window more robust to large residuals and then relaxes to baseline curvature, which is the direction implied by the early-window non-stationarity; C2 is the constant-curvature control and C3 is the opposite timing control. Dose is held fixed and teachers/temperatures are untouched, so this isolates the curvature-timing hypothesis. This is a proposed intervention level, not a parameter learned from the slope, and no current quality outcome is available to confirm benefit.
